blocks.text: WSJ: Nvidia’s board, which publicly backed Jensen Huang on Sunday, is now close to deciding whether to remove its founder CEO.

inlines.text: WSJ: Nvidia’s board, which publicly backed Jensen Huang on Sunday, is now close to deciding whether to remove its founder CEO.

blocks.text: The shift came as a second affair, with an Nvidia employee, surfaced alongside his admitted relationship with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset.

inlines.text: The shift came as a second affair, with an Nvidia employee, surfaced alongside his admitted relationship with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset.

blocks.text: When it opened an independent probe on Sunday, the board said it had no reason to believe Nvidia secrets were compromised.

inlines.text: When it opened an independent probe on Sunday, the board said it had no reason to believe Nvidia secrets were compromised.

blocks.text: Shares fell about 8% after hours, and Huang, the largest shareholder at about 3.6%, has rejected formal succession planning.

blocks.text: With roughly 60 direct reports and no named successor, Nvidia’s own proxy report warns that weak succession could hurt strategy and execution.
